This looks like about 6 strips of cooked bacon, possibly turkey bacon given the pinkish-brown color. Using the plate as a ruler (roughly 26 cm), each strip is about 10–15 cm long. Cooked strips like these typically weigh around 8–10 g each, which puts the total at about 55 g. At roughly 4.5 kcal/g for cooked bacon (turkey bacon would be somewhat lower), that comes to about 250 kcal.
